distribution.description: Distribute the current objectives across all locations: the solver decides where each item is produced and what is shipped between locations, delivering the objectives to the destination. Shipping from a planet uses rocket parts produced at the source; a space platform drops items without rockets. This is a large calculation and may take a few seconds.

planets.description: For each location, the production chain is solved using only recipes and machines available there. Items that cannot be produced locally are imported: the cheapest source location is chosen, and its buildings, resources and rocket parts are estimated and included (in parentheses). Fluids count 1/10 towards resources.

routes.description: Each route forces the listed recipe choices for this item and its ingredients, and solves the production chain for the current rate. Choices for other items are left to the solver.

science.description: Plan where to produce science packs. Packs are delivered to Nauvis: packs produced on other planets are shipped by rocket, and the rocket parts are produced at the same location. Packs produced on a space platform are dropped without rockets. Items that cannot be produced at a location are imported; hover an import to see where it can be produced.
science.summary: This plan needs {{ buildings }} buildings and {{ resources }} resources. Building every pack on Nauvis where possible would need {{ baselineBuildings }} buildings and {{ baselineResources }} resources.

science.empty: Select science packs to plan their production
science.logisticsDescription: Rocket silos are included in the buildings above. Space platforms are a rough estimate from the rocket loads per hour, using the assumptions below.
